thread:
marc: Quick ask from Compliance: customer audit teams want a compact report tying cost -> route -> trace id. Can we scope an MVP that meets audit needs without exploding metrics?

elaine: Proposal: make a "ledger" export that includes per-route cost rows with an example trace_id for each spike, plus basic latency/currency fields. Keep metrics dims limited to route, model_family, and cache_hit.

sam: Agree on limited dims. Runtime change: add span attrs route_id and cache_hit behind a flag. No prompt_template or full checkpoint tags to avoid cardinality.

nico: On ingestion, we should canonicalize route labels and keep a short route id (e.g., r_123) to reduce unique keys. Also store a representative trace_id per time-bucket for drill-down.

anya: UI: lightweight ledger tab on Console -> Observability. Rows: time-window, route, cost_usd, p99_ms, error_pct, sample_trace_id, export button. Default presets: 24h and 7d. Export modal: S3 + signed HTTPS upload for on-prem.

infra-bot: Heads-up: adding route_id to metrics requires a metrics-schema change and approval. Cardinality is billable.

marc: Launch checklist:
- emit span attrs: route_id, cache_hit
- ingestion canonicalization + representative trace selection
- ledger UI with export to CSV + secure transports
- canary rollout at 5% with sampling override for traces
- perf gate: p99 overhead <5%

elaine: Suggested rollback triggers: p99 > baseline*1.2 or metric ingestion lag > 60s or cardinality > threshold. Add automatic flag-off if any trigger hits.

sam: Implementation plan (short): sprint 1: runtime flag + canonicalization; sprint 2: ledger UI + CSV export; sprint 3: canary + audits & docs. Parallelize UI with runtime work.

nico: I'll draft a small algorithm for selecting "representative trace" per route per hour (highest-cost single request or p99 offender). Will post by Tue (1780000300).

anya: I'll mock ledger table and export modal by Wed (1780000400). Prefer compact table-first layout to speed dev.

marc: Compliance note: customer wants exports signed and KMS-wrapped. Also need an audit header (exported_by, timestamp, sha256). Add that to export format.

infra-bot: Reminder: file metrics-schema change ticket and include a cardinality cap proposal.

marc: OK team, proceed with scoped MVP; follow-up sync Thu to lock acceptance and create tickets. Thanks.
